attacks.claim: `.day-card` hardcodes `background: #ffffff` while `--text` flips to near-white in dark mode, so card text (and `--muted` meta text) becomes near-invisible on white cards for the ~30% of users in dark mode. This also fails WCAG AA contrast. `--surface` exists but is not used.

QA covered only light mode, so the dark-mode breakage was never exercised. The 360px lower bound of the mobile range, touch drag-and-drop on mobile, and any dark-mode contrast check are also missing, despite 68% mobile and 30% dark mode usage.
attacks.evidence: "Visual QA vs Figma: Chrome 1440px (light), Safari iPhone 14 (light) — pass, pixel diffs < 1%."

attacks.claim: On mobile the action bar is `position: fixed` at 72px, but `.planner` has no bottom padding to clear it. Sunday's tiles and their Swap/overflow buttons can sit under the bar and be unreachable, including for keyboard focus.
attacks.evidence: .action-bar { position: fixed; ... bottom: 0; height: 72px; ... } and .planner { ... padding: 16px; ... } with "Sunday is the last child of .planner"

attacks.claim: The one-tap tile-level "+ List" button is removed even though adding to the shopping list is the most frequent planner action (9.4/week, 64% on mobile). It is replaced by a five-step flow, with no task-completion or timing evidence that this is acceptable. Assistive-tech testing for this new flow is also not reported.
attacks.evidence: "The old tile-level \"+ List\" button is removed to declutter tiles." / "tap the tile → recipe page → \"Ingredients\" tab → choose servings in the servings sheet → \"Add to list\""

attacks.claim: The new bulk "Generate shopping list" write path has no QA evidence and no specified partial-failure, idempotency/double-tap, servings-default, or undo behavior. Only the single-recipe add has an Undo toast and a QA pass.
attacks.evidence: "\"Generate shopping list\" (adds all planned recipes for the week)" vs QA: "Shopping list add via recipe page + undo: pass"

attacks.claim: The release goes to 100% of web users at once even though a flag exists. There is no staged ramp, no numeric thresholds or abort criteria for the watch metrics, no named owner, and no flag-off rollback test.
attacks.evidence: "Ship to 100% Tue 10:00 PT behind `planner_v7`"; "Watch: planner page JS errors, shopping-list additions/WAU, planner bounce rate." — ABSENT: ramp, thresholds, rollback owner

attacks.claim: The "Share plan" button ships to all users with no definition of what is exposed, who can access the link, or whether it can expire or be revoked. It also has no QA coverage.
attacks.evidence: <button class="btn-ghost">Share plan</button> — ABSENT: sharing scope, link visibility, expiry/revocation

attacks.claim: Drag-to-move has no rule for a target day already holding 3 tiles, and no slot assignment is specified. The 3-tile invariant can break, and move failure handling is undefined.
attacks.evidence: "up to 3 recipe tiles (breakfast/lunch/dinner)" and "Drag a recipe tile between days to move it."
